## UC Design Blueprint

> **SSA offering — how to engage:** If you are interested in this SSA Offering, follow the ASQ process (go/gethelp): Product Help > Pilot/Production Advisory; then put the tag #ssa-offering #uc-design-blueprint in both the **Title** and **Description** fields.

**GOAL:** Simplify and accelerate UC design and deployment for customers with complex data governance needs via three working sessions

### Overview
The UC Design Blueprint is a structured workshop engagement that helps customers design and implement a robust Unity Catalog governance strategy. Through a series of collaborative working sessions, specialists guide customers from requirements gathering through best-practice design patterns to a completed first-pass UC design.

### Key Benefits
- **Expert-Guided Design**: Specialist-led sessions ensure best-practice UC governance patterns
- **Accelerated Time-to-Value**: Structured 4-step process delivers a UC design in ~5 weeks
- **Complex Governance Simplified**: Addresses multi-region, multi-cloud, multi-BU, and regulated environments (PII, PCI, PHI)
- **Competitive Positioning**: Strengthens UC positioning against Collibra, Immuta, Purview, Polaris, and other governance tools

### GTM Signals — When to Engage
- Customer planning EDW migration or UC deployment with no governance strategy
- Complex governance requirements: multi-region, multi-cloud, multi-BU, regulated environments with PII/PCI/PHI, or data residency concerns
- Battleground accounts with competing governance technologies (Iceberg interop, Alation, Collibra, Immuta, Purview, Polaris)
- Ad-hoc UC setup with no policy framework
- Customer asking: "How should we structure our UC hierarchy?", "How many metastores do we need?", "How does Collibra/Purview work with UC?"

### Technical Readiness Criteria
- L200 enablement complete; discovery done
- Cloud/platform, engineering & security teams available
- Has metastore admin, workspace admin, SCIM, CREATE Catalog rights
- Named technical owner who knows enterprise taxonomy

### Engagement Process (4-Step Joint Execution Plan)

**Step 1 — Preparation** (4hrs FTE / 0.5 wks)
- Prerequisite: Complete L200 enablement
- 1 Hour Sync: Review design blueprint process, Q&A. Agree on expected participants
- Next Steps: Schedule first session with agreed-upon customer team members

**Step 2 — Define & Validate Requirements** (8hrs FTE / 1 wk)
- Prerequisite: Expectations set for UC design blueprint process, relevant participants engaged
- 1-2 Hour Session: Define core governance requirements and administrative roles, review and discuss how to leverage existing UC features
- Next Steps: Identify governance gaps, map to business requirements. Specialist delivers best practices and potential workarounds

**Step 3 — UC Design Patterns Review** (16hrs FTE / 2 wks)
- Prerequisite: Documented business and technical requirements from previous session
- 2 Hour Session: Present best-practice UC design patterns. Map requirements to UC components and discuss effective options for implementation
- Next Steps: Initial design doc/diagram draft of UC governance proposal for scoped use case

**Step 4 — Whiteboard Design** (8+ hrs FTE / 1 wk)
- Prerequisite: Documented requirements and understanding of design patterns from previous two sessions
- 2 Hour Session: Whiteboarding session to define appropriate design for customer
- Next Steps: Continue iterating through design doc, validate onboarding/migration strategy for future use cases

### Customer Requirements
- Understanding of internal approval process to obtain sign-off on proposed UC design
- Active participation in design discussion; familiar with enterprise-level taxonomy and key requirements
- Representation from cloud/platform, engineering, and security teams as well as key decision makers
- **Databricks-specific privileges**: Metastore creation/usage, workspace creation/usage, user management/SCIM enablement, CREATE Catalog/Connections/Storage Credentials/External Locations
- **Cloud data store access**: Global AAD Admin, Privileged IAM Role (as applicable)
- **Existing governance tool access** (if any): Collibra, Immuta, Purview, Snowflake, etc.
